extra.message: SQL Injection in Student.create(): User-supplied 'name' parameter is interpolated directly into SQL query using Python string formatting (% operator). The query 'INSERT INTO students (name) VALUES ('%(name)s')' with string interpolation allows attackers to inject malicious SQL code.

SQL Injection in Student.get_many(): The LIMIT and OFFSET clauses use string concatenation with user-controlled parameters. While this uses named parameters, the values are concatenated into the query string using Python string formatting (% operator), making it vulnerable to SQL injection.

SQL Injection in Course.get_many(): The cur.execute() call incorrectly uses **params (dictionary unpacking) instead of passing params as a tuple or dict directly. This could lead to SQL injection if user-controlled limit/offset values are passed.

Weak Password Hashing: User passwords are hashed using unsalted MD5 (md5(password.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()). MD5 is cryptographically broken and vulnerable to rainbow table attacks. Without salt, identical passwords produce identical hashes.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort
CWE-759: Use of a One-Way Hash without a Salt

extra.message: Stored XSS: course.title and course.description are rendered without HTML escaping in the template. Since autoescape=False is set in app.py, malicious JavaScript in course title or description will execute in users' browsers.
Stored XSS: review.review_text is rendered without HTML escaping. Since autoescape=False is set in app.py, malicious JavaScript stored in review text will execute in users' browsers.

Stored XSS: course.title and course.description are rendered without HTML escaping in the template. Since autoescape=False is set in app.py, malicious JavaScript in course data will execute in users' browsers.
Stored XSS: Student name is rendered without HTML escaping. Since autoescape=False is set in app.py, malicious JavaScript in student name will execute when displayed in the students list.
Security Misconfiguration: Jinja2 autoescape is explicitly disabled (autoescape=False). This allows XSS attacks as all template variables are rendered without HTML escaping by default.
CSRF Protection Disabled: The csrf_middleware is commented out in the middlewares list. All POST requests are vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery attacks since there is no CSRF token validation.

Missing Authentication: The students() view function lacks authentication decorator. While the form is hidden in the template for non-authenticated users, the POST endpoint can still be accessed directly without authentication, allowing unauthorized student creation.
